newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Senate panel OKs $3 bln school bond plan.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Senate panel OKs $3 bln school bond plan.

text.p: A key California state Senate panel approved legislation that would place a $3 billion bond measure to fund school construction on the ballot, state officials said Thursday.
The state Senate Education Committee approved Senate Bill 15, proposed by Senator Leroy Greene, with a 9-to-3 vote. The measure will next be heard in the state Senate Appropriations Committee.
The measure would provide up to $1 billion to build facilities to help reduce class sizes. The rest of money would fund school reconstruction projects and other improvements.

If approved by state lawmakers, the bond measure would be placed before voters at a special election on June 3, 1997. Greene's proposal is one of several school bond measures under consideration by the state Legislature.
